title: Kingdoms Connected Scripting API
tagline: Script your own Kingdom Come: Deliverance II multiplayer server in JavaScript or TypeScript: spawn points, commands, NPCs, quests, shops, menus and whole game modes.

principles.title: Running in ten minutes
principles.description: Unpack a release, build the default gamemode, join your own server. Getting started walks you through it, then through your first resource.

principles.title: The whole of Bohemia to script
principles.description: Players, horses, dogs, NPCs, props, doors, the clock and the weather, quests, dialogue and shops, all from your own code.

principles.title: Two halves, one resource
principles.description: The server owns the rules and everything players share. The client half binds keys, draws HUDs and opens HTML menus in each player's game.

principles.title: Hot reload
principles.description: Type ensure in the server console and your resource reloads without a restart, pushing new client code to everyone connected.

principles.title: Checked, not guessed
principles.description: The API reference is generated from the runtime itself, and every sample in the guides is type-checked against the published declarations.

principles.title: Built to host
principles.description: Windows and Linux servers, an official Docker image and a Pterodactyl egg, and a listing in the in-game server browser.
